update CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION
BOOKDATE = #{bookdate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
STARTDATE = #{startdate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
ENDDATE = #{enddate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
INVEST_VARIETY = #{investVariety,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
ASSET_CODE = #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
ASSETTYPE = #{assettype,jdbcType=VARCHAR},

update CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION set BOOKDATE = #{bookdate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, STARTDATE = #{startdate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, ENDDATE = #{enddate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, INVEST_VARIETY = #{investVariety,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ASSET_CODE = #{assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ASSETTYPE = #{assettype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ASSETVALUE_A = #{assetvalueA,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, ASSETVALUE_B = #{assetvalueB,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, INDUSTRY1 = #{industry1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IN_ASSET_TYPE = #{inAssetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PPPFLAG = #{pppflag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MONIT_TYPE = #{monitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MANAGE_TYPE = #{manageType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IS_GOVERN_FUND1 = #{isGovernFund1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PRIVATEFUND_FLAG = #{privatefundFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PRIVATEPRD_FLAG = #{privateprdFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG = #{bondtostockFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RATING = #{rating,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ASSETTYPE2 = #{assettype2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TERMS = #{terms,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, SUNASSETTYPE = #{sunassettype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SUNASSETTYPE2 = #{sunassettype2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where POSUUID = #{posuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.select: select pos.PLAN_ASSET_ID ,pos.TOTAL_NUM ,pos.ISSUE_AMT ,pos.asset_code ,pos.POS_NUM ,pos.POS_AMT ,pos.POS_DATE ,pos.ISFINAPLAN ,#{accuamt} ACCUAMT from CHB_BOT_AST_POS pos left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on pos.asset_code=info.asset_code where pos.PLAN_ASSET_ID = #{planAssetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pos.POS_DATE=#{posDate,jdbcType=DATE} and pos.status !='D' and info.status!='D' and pos.asset_code!='REMAININGCASH'

select sum(POSITION.ASSETVALUE_A) ASSETVALUE_A, sum(POSITION.ASSETVALUE_B) ASSETVALUE_B, POSITION.ASSETTYPE, ifnull(POSITION.INDUSTRY1,'NULL') INDUSTRY1, POSITION.IN_ASSET_TYPE, POSITION.PPPFLAG, POSITION.MONIT_TYPE, POSITION.MANAGE_TYPE, POSITION.IS_GOVERN_FUND1, POSITION.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG, POSITION.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG, POSITION.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG, POSITION.RATING,POSITION.ASSETTYPE2,ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE3, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_CAPITAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PERPETUAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PREFER from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION POSITION LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE = POSITION.ASSET_CODE and ASSETINFO.status in('E','M') where DATE_FORMAT(POSITION.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT(POSITION.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by POSITION.ASSETTYPE, ifnull(POSITION.INDUSTRY1,'NULL'), POSITION.IN_ASSET_TYPE, POSITION.PPPFLAG, POSITION.MONIT_TYPE, POSITION.MANAGE_TYPE, POSITION.IS_GOVERN_FUND1, POSITION.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG, POSITION.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG, POSITION.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG, POSITION.RATING, POSITION.ASSETTYPE2,ASSETINFO.ASSET_TYPE3, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_CAPITAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PERPETUAL, ASSETINFO.BANK_SEC_PREFER

SELECT SUM(cashflow) cashamt,CCY ccy,PROD_ID prodId FROM (SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '03' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 WHEN '04' THEN 0 WHEN '05' THEN 0 WHEN '14' THEN 0 WHEN '15' THEN 0 WHEN '16' THEN ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) * -1 WHEN '17' THEN (ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+ifnull(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 ELSE ifnull(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND TRADE_TYPE NOT IN ('05','14','15') and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '04' THEN ifnull(prdeal.INT_AMT, 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE INTEREST_DATE<=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM(-1*ifnull(fee.AMT,0 ))cashflow, fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_fee_deal fee left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=fee.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE fee.PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND fee.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID ) base GROUP BY CCY,PROD_ID

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*ifnull(deal.AMT,0) else ifnull(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.CHL_CPCT_ID is null and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*ifnull(deal.AMT,0) else ifnull(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type !='02' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT SUM(UNINVEST_CASH) CASHAMT FROM( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05'and deal.status !='D' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03') and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D') de

select cp.PROD_ID prodId,Round((cp.accuqty/aq.qty)*ap.UNINVEST_CASH,2) cashamt, AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID oldAssetCode,ci.ccy from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_asset_position deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}) and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D' and UNINVEST_CASH !=0) ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE left join (select sum(cp.accuqty) qty,cp.ASSET_CODE from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP by cp.ASSET_CODE) aq on aq.ASSET_CODE=cp.ASSET_CODE left join chb_asset_info ci on ci.ASSET_CODE=AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID and ci.status !='D' where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT PROD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PRODID,/*产品代码*/ BALANCE.O_AMT assetvalueA,/*穿透前*/ BALANCE.O_AMT assetvalueB,/*穿透后*/ PRD.IS_FHXGCP, BALANCE.O_CCY CCY/*币种:关联资产要素信息表CHB_ASSET_INFO得到币种CCY*/ FROM BOK_BALANCE BALANCE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD/*标的类金融产品表*/ ON PROD.FINPROD_ID = BALANCE.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO PRD ON PRD.PROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 =1 AND DATE_FORMAT(BALANCE.BALANCE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') AND BALANCE.SUBJECT_NO in ('2102','2202','2203','2204','2205','2206','2207','2210','2221','2231','2241','2501')

select #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE} bookdate ,#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} enddate ,info.ASSET_CODE ,info.asset_type assettype ,info.ASSET_TYPE2 assettype2 ,ifnull(ifnull(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES) INDUSTRY1 /*所属行业*/ ,info.IN_ASSET_TYPE ,ifnull(ifnull(c.rating ,d.rating),ifnull(a.rating,b.rating)) rating /*债券评级*/ ,if(info.PRIVATE_FLAG='01','01',null) MONIT_TYPE ,if(info.PPPFLAG='01','01',null) PPPFLAG ,if(info.IS_GOVERN_FUND='01','01',null) IS_GOVERN_FUND1 ,if(info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG='01','01',null) PRIVATEFUND_FLAG ,if(info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG='01','01',null) PRIVATEPRD_FLAG ,if(info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG='01','01',null) BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG ,info.MANAGE_TYPE MANAGE_TYPE /*管理方式*/ from CHB_ASSET_INFO info
left join a on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=b.ASSET_CODE
left join a on info.ASSET_CODE=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on info.ASSET_CODE=b.ASSET_CODE
left join c on info.ASSET_CODE=c.ASSET_CODE left join d on info.ASSET_CODE=d.ASSET_CODE where 1=1 and info.status !='D'
group by #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE},info.ASSET_CODE, info.asset_type, info.ASSET_TYPE2, ifnull(ifnull(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES), info.IN_ASSET_TYPE, null,ifnull(c.rating,a.rating), if(info.PRIVATE_FLAG='01','01',null), if(info.PPPFLAG='01','01',null), if(info.IS_GOVERN_FUND='01','01',null), if(info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG='01','01',null), if(info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG='01','01',null), if(info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG='01','01',null), info.MANAGE_TYPE

WITH ap AS ( SELECT DISTINCT case when cbap.ASSET_CODE = 'REMAININGCASH' then cbap.POS_AMT else cbap.UNINVEST_CASH end as UNINVEST_CASH, cbap.PLAN_ASSET_ID,cbap.TOTAL_NUM FROM chb_bot_ast_pos cbap inner join chb_asset_position deal on cbap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=deal.ASSET_CODE and deal.trade_type = '05' and deal.CDATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} inner join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd ON prd.PROD_ID = deal.PROD_ID AND prd.status != 'D' AND prd.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' where cbap.pos_date = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND cbap.status != 'D' AND (cbap.ASSET_CODE = 'REMAININGCASH' or (cbap.UNINVEST_CASH !=0 and not exists(select TT.PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos TT where TT.ASSET_CODE = 'REMAININGCASH' and cbap.PLAN_ASSET_ID =TT.PLAN_ASSET_ID)) ) ) SELECT cp.PROD_ID AS prodId , Round(cp.accuqty / ap.TOTAL_NUM * ap.UNINVEST_CASH, 2) AS cashamt , AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID AS oldAssetCode, ci.ccy,prd.IS_FHXGCP isFhxgcp FROM chb_asset_position cp INNER JOIN ap ON ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID = cp.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN chb_asset_info ci ON ci.ASSET_CODE = AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID AND ci.status != 'D' LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd ON prd.PROD_ID = cp.PROD_ID WHERE cp.CDATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND prd.PROFIT_TYPE = '03'
